title: AWS Marketplace Registration Completion Request
description: Authenticated claim of a pending AWS Marketplace registration into the caller's own tenant. `registration_id` is the wire field name kept for API compatibility -- the value is the raw bearer handle returned by POST /register's redirect, not a database id. `tenant_id`, if supplied, is only accepted as an assertion that MUST equal the authenticated session's own tenant (a mismatch is rejected with 403); it never selects which tenant is claimed into. See src/routes/marketplace_routes.py:complete.

registration_id.description: Raw bearer handle for the pending registration (format mpr_<token>), not a database id.

tenant_id.description: Optional assertion of the target tenant. Must equal the authenticated session's own tenant (src/security/tenant_context.py:get_current_tenant_id) or the request is rejected with 403.
